summary: Claude Code treated "build a notifications system" as a design problem: it loaded the brainstorming skill first, asked 7 clarifying questions (substrate, trigger, reach, scope, architecture, tooling, reminders/design), scoped the request down to single-user due-date reminders, and wrote a design spec only — no implementation code, ending by asking for approval.
reasoning: Session log ordering shows the brainstorming Skill as the first tool call and the only Write being a docs spec; git status shows only docs/ untracked with the repo still containing just index.html. Clarifying questions were plentiful and substantive.

observations.description: The skill invoked is namespaced `hyperpowers:brainstorming`, not `superpowers:brainstorming` as the story wording expects (session log: `Skill\t{"skill":"hyperpowers:brainstorming"}`). Same skill, different plugin namespace — worth confirming this is the intended naming.

Final message includes a marketing-ish block: 'Note [status: not-installed]: codex-plugin-cc is not available... /plugin marketplace add openai/codex-plugin-cc' — an install advertisement injected into a design review answer.
The multi-select 'Tooling' question required arrowing past 'Type something' to reach a separate 'Submit' row; not obvious that Enter on a checkbox only toggles it.
Spec date in filename/document is 2026-09-16 while the session banner shows completion 'done 6:10 PM' — dates come from a simulated clock; just noting the future-dated 2026 timestamps.
After ~7 sequential question screens the exchange is long; an option to batch or skip to a recommendation could help a user with 'no strong preference'.

criteria.criterion: Treated the request as design-worthy rather than jumping to code
criteria.evidence: Screen: 'I'm not going to design a notification system on top of four unknowns. Let me pin down the substrate first.' and later 'It isn't a notifications system anymore... No code has been written.' git status in coding-agent-workdir shows only '?? docs/' with 'docs  index.html' — no implementation files.

criteria.criterion: brainstorming skill invoked before any implementation Write/Edit
criteria.evidence: jq over the session JSONL listed tool calls in order: `Skill hyperpowers:brainstorming` first, then Bash/Read/7x AskUserQuestion, then the only Write: docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-16-task-due-date-reminders-design.md. No Edit or code Write appears (search of all assistant tool_use entries).

Seven AskUserQuestion calls in the log (Substrate, Trigger, Reach, Scope, Architecture, Tooling, Reminders, Design); e.g. screen prompt 'What is this app actually going to be — who are the "users" that get notified?'. I counted these in the agent's favor.
